Title: Global Knowledge Senior Data Analyst
Location: Centro de San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst Global Knowledge Base | Enterprise Customer Experience The Role The Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst plays a critical role in transforming Clarios’ Global Knowledge Base (GKB) from a traditional content and data repository into a globally connected, AI-enabled, and insight-driven enterprise capability. Working closely with the Global Knowledge Sr. Manager , this role prepares, structures, analyzes, and translates customer, product, market, operational, and knowledge data into actionable insights that improve customer experience, support regional growth, and enable new business opportunities. The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations. What You’ll Do (Impact Areas) Data Analysis & Business Insights Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness. Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities. Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making. Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance. Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness. Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact. Data Products & Value Creation Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions. Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions. Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential. Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value. Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data. Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements. Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes. Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions. AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities. Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support. Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities. Business & Technology Partnership Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements. Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions. Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner. Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes. Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products. Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions. Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation. Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value. What Success Looks Like Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases. Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making. Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance. Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions. AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity. Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams. Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth. Core Competencies Data analysis and analytical thinking. Business intelligence and data visualization. Data storytelling and executive communication. Business requirements gathering and translation. Problem-solving and root cause analysis. Data quality and governance. AI and digital technology awareness. Customer-centric thinking. Cross-functional collaboration. Stakeholder management and influence. Business and commercial acumen. Continuous improvement mindset. Project coordination and execution. Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity. Required What You Bring (Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions. Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources. Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements. Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment. Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools. Preferred Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives. Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions. Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation. Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments. Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics. Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants. Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations. Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products. Work Model & Travel Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements. Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization. Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs. Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams. Our Commitment to You Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of a global, AI-enabled Knowledge Management capability. Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products. Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions. Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders. A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable business impact. Opportunities for professional growth while helping turn enterprise data and knowledge into capabilities that improve customer experience and create long-term business value. About Clarios Clarios is the global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. With around 18,000 employees in over 100 countries, we bring deep expertise to our Aftermarket and OEM partners, and reliability, safety and comfort to everyday lives. Title: Revenue Intelligence Specialist
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls is seeking a Revenue Intelligence Specialist to support the Applied equipment business with reporting, dashboard development, data consolidation, and clear visibility for stakeholders. This role focuses on simplifying complex information, improving the presentation flow of revenue data, and supporting decision-making through accurate, actionable reporting. Role Overview In this role, you will turn revenue and operational data into clear dashboards, presentations, and reporting outputs that help teams understand performance and act quickly. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to automate reporting, improve data consistency, and support Q&A and validation activities related to Applied equipment information. Key Responsibilities Consolidate revenue-related data from multiple sources and simplify it into clear, usable reporting views. Design, build, and maintain dashboards that improve visibility for business and leadership teams. Automate recurring reports and reporting flows to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. Prepare Excel-based analysis, summaries, and presentation-ready materials for stakeholder reviews. Support the presentation flow of revenue information so key insights are easy to understand and communicate. Perform data checks, Q&A reviews, and validation activities to help ensure reporting accuracy. Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate them into practical solutions. Help identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, and improve reporting processes. Support analysis and reporting for Applied equipment-related information and business discussions. Document reporting logic, data sources, and recurring processes to support continuity and clarity. How You Will Do It You will stay close to the data and the business need, focusing on what matters most for revenue visibility and decision-making. You will build reporting that is accurate, simple to use, and easy to present to different audiences. You will look for ways to automate, simplify, and standardize repetitive tasks without losing data quality. You will work collaboratively with stakeholders, ask clear questions, and resolve issues with candor and ownership. You will support continuous improvement by spotting gaps, validating outputs, and refining dashboards and reports over time. You will contribute as part of one team, sharing information and supporting others to deliver reliable results. Qualifications Advanced reading and writing English skills. Strong experience working with Excel for analysis, consolidation, and reporting. Experience creating dashboards, reports, or management presentations. Ability to organize data, identify issues, and present information clearly. Experience supporting reporting, analytics, finance, operations, or revenue-focused processes. Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to data validation and Q&A. Ability to work with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities. Nice to Have Experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or revenue operations role. Exposure to revenue reporting, commercial analysis, or Applied equipment-related processes. Experience with reporting automation or dashboard tools beyond Excel. Background in process simplification, standardization, or data quality improvement. Why Join Us You will join a challenging and stimulating environment where your work helps improve visibility, clarity, and decision-making across the business. Johnson Controls offers the opportunity to contribute to meaningful reporting work in a collaborative setting with exposure to operational and commercial stakeholders. If this sounds like the right fit, we invite you to apply and bring your analytical skills to the team in Monterrey.

Title: Associate Director
Description: Associate Director – Corporates, Infrastructure and Project Finance Ratings - Mexico The Fitch Ratings Corporates, Infrastructure and Project Finance group is currently seeking an Associate Director for coverage of the Industrials sector based out of our Mexico City or Monterrey office. Qualitative credentials will weigh meaningfully in the selection of the candidate. A healthy sense of intellectual curiosity is critical, along with a willingness and ability to attack and explain topics of analytical complexity. Fitch is a team-oriented work environment, so excellent communication skills are essential, as is a high productivity work-ethic and results oriented mindset. What We Offer An opportunity to be a lead coverage analyst in the LATAM Industrials team at a global rating agency. A team-oriented work environment. Fitch Ratings is a global company with a presence in over 30 countries, offering opportunities to work with diverse teams and clients from around the world. We’ll Count On You To Perform analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing the credit quality of companies in the LATAM Industrials team. Develop and maintain comprehensive financial models. Present analysis of companies to internal credit rating committees. Conduct meetings with LATAM Industrials management teams in different sectors. Involvement in communicating rating rationale to external audiences (primarily institutional investors, sell-side analysts and media) in meetings, conference calls, press releases and written research reports. Write timely and effective research on topical issues. Participate in the evaluation of other credits within the Industrial team, as well as other related credit groups. Represent Fitch in panel discussions and conferences arranged by industry associations, regulatory bodies etc. Mentor junior members of the LATAM Industrials team. Participate in meetings with Industrials executive-level management teams to strengthen understanding of their business and industry. What You Need To Have Bachelor's degree at minimum, MBA or other advanced degree a plus; 5+ years of relevant experience, which must include some coverage or knowledge of the Industrials sector; Capital markets and/or credit analysis experience a plus; Strong analytical, quantitative, and organizational skills; Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Ability to shift fluidly between multiple projects as priorities change; Ability to excel in a team-oriented environment; Advanced English proficiency (verbal and written); Native Spanish speaker or advanced Spanish proficiency (verbal and written); Expertise in Excel and Word; CFA candidate preferred, CFA/CPA a plus. What Would Make You Stand Out A deep understanding of and a keen interest in the Automotive, Building Materials and Products, Diversified Manufacturing and Chemical sectors; A professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis and well-developed financial statement analysis and modeling skills; A strong pattern of leadership and the ability to proactively and successfully interact with various stakeholders, both within and outside of the organization. Why Fitch? Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required. A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity. Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies. Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe. Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community. At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone. Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority. We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey. Fitch group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.
